title: Three Master's Students from SmartAgri UGM Graduate, Bringing Research and Collaboration Spirit for Modern Agriculture
excerpt: Yogyakarta, October 29, 2026: Three students from the Master's Program in Agricultural Engineering at FTP UGM, who are members of the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) UGM, completed their master's education and participated in the graduation ceremony on Thursday (29/10). body:
**Yogyakarta, October 29, 2026:** Three students from the Master's Program in Agricultural Engineering at FTP UGM, who are members of the Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) UGM, completed their master's education and participated in the graduation ceremony on Thursday (29/10). The three graduates are Arifa Haryani, S.T., M.Sc., Yusfan Ramela Putra, S.T.P., M.Sc., and Hammam Mananda Harahap, S.T., M.Sc.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-1-image-11-1030x454.webp)

During their studies, the three of them developed research on plant physiology monitoring, irrigation system modeling, and precision fertilization potential mapping. Through different topics, the research was directed to support the development of data-based agricultural technology and management.

Their journey in completing their studies was supported by the SmartAgri research environment through discussions, collaborative data collection and processing, and shared learning. For the three of them, SmartAgri became a space to expand their knowledge while building confidence in facing research challenges.

**Plant Monitoring Research and International Collaboration Experience**

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-2-image-12-1030x440.webp)

Arifa Haryani completed research on the performance evaluation of a Visible–Near Infrared (Vis–NIR) spectroscopy-based plant physiology monitoring system in a controlled environment. This research utilized the AS7265X spectroscopy sensor integrated with a microcontroller and the AGRARISE dashboard to support data collection and monitoring.

In completing her research, Arifa was guided by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. as Supervising Lecturer I and Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nazmi Mat Nawi as Supervising Lecturer II. The examining lecturers involved were Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, M.Eng. as Examining Lecturer I and Prof. Dr. Mohammad Affan Fajar Falah, S.T.P., M.Agr. as Examining Lecturer II.

Arifa stated that her involvement in SmartAgri helped her adaptation process during her master's studies. Although initially feeling awkward, the openness of her team members in involving her in various activities helped her find the research direction she wanted to develop.

> "During my research, I was helped by my research team friends. Whenever there was a problem, we discussed it until it was resolved, so there was always progress every week," said Arifa.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-3-image-13-1030x472.webp)

According to her, this support made the research that initially felt burdensome become easier to pursue until she could complete her studies on time. One of the most memorable experiences was the opportunity to participate in a joint supervision program at UPM, Malaysia, which allowed her to receive research guidance from lecturers there.

That experience broadened her perspective on the future of agriculture, particularly the development of affordable, time-saving, and labor-saving technology. She also considered laboratory facilities and international collaboration opportunities to be important support for students who want to deepen their understanding of precision agriculture.

Arifa hopes that research and collaboration can continue to generate appropriate technology that addresses farmers' needs. For her, climate, time, and labor challenges serve as drivers to develop useful agricultural technology while still paying attention to its environmental impact.

**Irrigation Modeling and Personal Meaning of Graduation**

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-4-image-14-1030x487.webp)

Yusfan Ramela Putra developed research titled "Development of Unsteady Flow Model in Gate Operation of Tap Division with Control System in the Kengkeng Secondary Channel of Sapon Kulon Progo Irrigation Area." This research discusses changes in water flow due to irrigation gate operations and alternative control methods to maintain water level stability.

The research was supervised by Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. as Supervising Lecturer I and Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. as Supervising Lecturer II. The examining lecturers consisted of Dr. Ir. Radi, S.T.P., M.Eng. as Examining Lecturer I and Hanggar Ganara Mawandha, S.T., M.Eng., Ph.D. as Examining Lecturer II.

In his research journey, Yusfan felt the role of SmartAgri as a learning platform, especially in writing scientific publications. The support and experience of colleagues in that research environment helped him understand the publication writing process, which previously felt unfamiliar to him.

> "The most memorable thing is how SmartAgri supported me in writing scientific publications. I was very unfamiliar with this and felt inspired and encouraged by my SmartAgri colleagues," he said.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-5-image-15-1030x602.webp)

For Yusfan, his master's graduation also held personal meaning related to his father's educational journey. He recalled that his father had studied at UGM in 1970 but had to stop in the first semester.

> "I hope this S2 opportunity opens a new path for me and brings a special moment of happiness for my father," said Yusfan.

**Precision Fertilization Mapping and Shared Learning Space**

Hammam Mananda Harahap completed research on the development of a grid zonation model for precision fertilization potential in rice plants based on UAV-VTOL imagery using machine learning. This research utilized multispectral imagery from an unmanned aerial vehicle and plant condition measurements to develop a map of fertilization requirement potential zones.

In his research, Hammam was guided by Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. as Supervising Lecturer I and Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, M.Eng. as Supervising Lecturer II. The examining lecturers were Dr. Ngadisih, S.T.P., M.Sc. as Examining Lecturer I and Dr. Ir. Radi, S.T.P., M.Eng. as Examining Lecturer II.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-6-image-16-1030x434.webp)

Hammam expressed that SmartAgri played a major role in helping him keep pace with scientific and research developments during his master's studies. Initially, he found it difficult to match the various research approaches that were newly introduced to him. Through guidance and discussions together, he had the opportunity to learn methods that he had never tried before.

> "SmartAgri is a family that has greatly helped me during my master's study years," said Hammam.

One of the things he valued most was the culture of open discussion without distinguishing educational levels. According to him, this atmosphere made knowledge exchange more intense and helped him understand the importance of humility in learning.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-7-image-17-1030x533.webp)

His experience during master's education also taught him to appreciate others' abilities and remain open to new knowledge. He expressed gratitude to the SmartAgri family for the support and learning provided during his academic journey.

The graduation of Arifa, Yusfan, and Hammam demonstrates the role of a collaborative research environment in supporting the completion of education and the development of student capabilities. Their experience shows that open discussion, peer support, and opportunities for collaboration can help students overcome research challenges.

With the knowledge and experience they have gained, the three of them are expected to continue contributing through the advancement of agricultural science and technology. Research on plant monitoring, irrigation management, and precision fertilization is part of an effort to realize more efficient, adaptive, and sustainable agriculture.

#### Connection to SDGs

-   SDG 2 – Zero Hunger, through research supporting plant management and the development of food production technology.
-   SDG 4 – Quality Education, through the completion of master's education, research-based learning, and knowledge exchange in the academic environment.
-   SDG 6 – Clean Water and Sanitation, through research on irrigation modeling and control directed to support agricultural water management.
-   SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure, through the development of plant monitoring systems, irrigation control models, and technology-based fertilization mapping.
-   SDG 12 – Responsible Consumption and Production, through research supporting more targeted use of water, fertilizer, and agricultural resources.
-   SDG 17 – Partnerships for the Goals, through research collaboration, inter-student learning, and international academic collaboration.

original.body:
**Yogyakarta, 29 Oktober 2026:** Tiga mahasiswa Program Studi Magister Teknik Pertanian FTP UGM, yang tergabung dalam Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) UGM, menyelesaikan pendidikan magister dan mengikuti wisuda pada Kamis (29/10). Ketiga wisudawan tersebut adalah Arifa Haryani, S.T., M.Sc., Yusfan Ramela Putra, S.T.P., M.Sc., dan Hammam Mananda Harahap, S.T., M.Sc.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-1-image-11-1030x454.webp)

Selama menempuh pendidikan, ketiganya mengembangkan penelitian mengenai pemantauan fisiologi tanaman, pemodelan sistem irigasi, serta pemetaan potensi pemupukan presisi. Melalui topik yang berbeda, penelitian tersebut diarahkan untuk mendukung pengembangan teknologi dan pengelolaan pertanian berbasis data.

Perjalanan mereka dalam menyelesaikan studi turut didukung oleh lingkungan riset SmartAgri melalui diskusi, kerja sama pengambilan dan pengolahan data, serta pembelajaran bersama. Bagi ketiganya, SmartAgri menjadi ruang untuk memperluas pengetahuan sekaligus membangun kepercayaan diri dalam menghadapi tantangan penelitian.

**Riset Pemantauan Tanaman dan Pengalaman Kolaborasi Internasional**

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-2-image-12-1030x440.webp)

Arifa Haryani menyelesaikan penelitian mengenai evaluasi kinerja sistem pemantauan fisiologi tanaman berbasis spektroskopi _Visible–Near Infrared_ (Vis–NIR) dalam lingkungan terkendali. Penelitian ini menggunakan sensor spektroskopi AS7265X yang diintegrasikan dengan mikrokontroler dan dasbor AGRARISE untuk mendukung pengambilan serta pemantauan data.

Dalam penyelesaian penelitiannya, Arifa dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. selaku Dosen Pembimbing I dan Assoc. Prof. Dr. Nazmi Mat Nawi selaku Dosen Pembimbing II. Adapun dosen penguji yang terlibat adalah Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, M.Eng. sebagai Dosen Penguji I dan Prof. Dr. Mohammad Affan Fajar Falah, S.T.P., M.Agr. sebagai Dosen Penguji II.

Arifa menuturkan bahwa keterlibatannya di SmartAgri membantu proses adaptasi selama menempuh pendidikan magister. Meskipun awalnya merasa canggung, keterbukaan rekan-rekan tim dalam melibatkannya pada berbagai kegiatan membantunya menemukan arah penelitian yang ingin dikembangkan.

> “Selama melakukan penelitian saya dibantu oleh teman-teman tim riset. Setiap ada kendala didiskusikan sampai kendala itu terselesaikan, sehingga selalu ada saja progres tiap minggunya,” ungkap Arifa.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-3-image-13-1030x472.webp)

Menurutnya, dukungan tersebut membuat penelitian yang semula terasa berat menjadi lebih mudah dijalani hingga ia dapat menyelesaikan studi tepat waktu. Salah satu pengalaman paling berkesan adalah kesempatan mengikuti program _joint supervision_ di UPM, Malaysia, yang memungkinkan dirinya memperoleh bimbingan riset dari dosen di sana.

Pengalaman tersebut memperluas pandangannya mengenai pertanian masa depan, khususnya pengembangan teknologi yang terjangkau, hemat waktu, dan hemat tenaga. Ia juga menilai fasilitas laboratorium serta kesempatan kolaborasi internasional menjadi dukungan penting bagi mahasiswa yang ingin mendalami pertanian presisi.

Arifa berharap riset dan kolaborasi dapat terus menghasilkan teknologi tepat guna yang menjawab kebutuhan petani. Baginya, tantangan iklim, waktu, dan tenaga menjadi dorongan untuk mengembangkan teknologi pertanian yang bermanfaat serta tetap memperhatikan dampaknya terhadap lingkungan.

**Pemodelan Irigasi dan Makna Personal Kelulusan**

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-4-image-14-1030x487.webp)

Yusfan Ramela Putra mengembangkan penelitian berjudul “Pengembangan Model _Unsteady Flow_ pada Operasi Pintu Bagi Sadap dengan Sistem Kendali di Saluran Sekunder Kengkeng Daerah Irigasi Sapon Kulon Progo”. Penelitian ini membahas perubahan aliran air akibat operasi pintu irigasi serta alternatif pengendaliannya untuk menjaga kestabilan tinggi muka air.

Penelitian tersebut dibimbing oleh Dr. Murtiningrum, S.T.P., M.Eng. selaku Dosen Pembimbing I dan Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. selaku Dosen Pembimbing II. Sementara itu, dosen penguji terdiri atas Dr. Ir. Radi, S.T.P., M.Eng. sebagai Dosen Penguji I dan Hanggar Ganara Mawandha, S.T., M.Eng., Ph.D. sebagai Dosen Penguji II.

Dalam perjalanan risetnya, Yusfan merasakan peran SmartAgri sebagai wadah belajar, terutama dalam penulisan naskah publikasi ilmiah. Dukungan dan pengalaman rekan-rekan di lingkungan riset tersebut membantunya mengenal proses penulisan yang sebelumnya masih terasa asing.

> “Hal yang paling berkesan bagaimana SmartAgri mendukung dalam penulisan naskah publikasi. Saya sangat awam tentang ini dan merasa terinspirasi dan terdorong oleh rekan-rekan SmartAgri,” tuturnya.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-5-image-15-1030x602.webp)

Bagi Yusfan, kelulusan magister juga memiliki makna personal yang berkaitan dengan perjalanan pendidikan ayahnya. Ia mengenang bahwa sang ayah pernah menempuh kuliah di UGM pada 1970, tetapi harus berhenti pada semester pertama.

> “Kesempatan kuliah S2 ini semoga memberikan jalan baru bagi saya, dan secuil kebahagiaan tersendiri bagi bapak saya,” ungkap Yusfan.

**Pemetaan Pemupukan Presisi dan Ruang Belajar Bersama**

Hammam Mananda Harahap menyelesaikan penelitian mengenai pengembangan model grid zonasi potensi pemupukan presisi pada tanaman padi berbasis citra UAV-VTOL menggunakan _machine learning_. Penelitian ini memanfaatkan citra multispektral dari wahana udara nirawak serta pengukuran kondisi tanaman untuk menyusun peta zona potensi kebutuhan pemupukan.

Dalam penelitiannya, Hammam dibimbing oleh Ir. Andri Prima Nugroho, M.Sc., Ph.D. selaku Dosen Pembimbing I dan Prof. Dr. Ir. Lilik Sutiarso, M.Eng. selaku Dosen Pembimbing II. Adapun dosen pengujinya adalah Dr. Ngadisih, S.T.P., M.Sc. sebagai Dosen Penguji I dan Dr. Ir. Radi, S.T.P., M.Eng. sebagai Dosen Penguji II.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-6-image-16-1030x434.webp)

Hammam mengungkapkan bahwa SmartAgri memiliki peran besar dalam membantunya mengikuti perkembangan ilmu dan penelitian selama studi magister. Pada awalnya, ia merasa kesulitan mengimbangi berbagai pendekatan riset yang baru dikenalnya. Melalui pendampingan dan diskusi bersama, ia memperoleh kesempatan untuk mempelajari metode yang sebelumnya belum pernah dicoba.

> “SmartAgri adalah keluarga yang banyak membantu saya dalam tahun-tahun kuliah S2 saya,” ungkap Hammam.

Salah satu hal yang paling ia hargai adalah budaya diskusi yang terbuka tanpa membedakan jenjang pendidikan. Menurutnya, suasana tersebut membuat pertukaran pengetahuan berlangsung lebih intens dan membantunya memahami pentingnya kerendahan hati dalam belajar.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1127-7-image-17-1030x533.webp)

Pengalaman selama pendidikan magister juga mengajarkannya untuk menghargai kemampuan orang lain serta terus terbuka terhadap pengetahuan baru. Ia menyampaikan terima kasih kepada keluarga besar SmartAgri atas dukungan dan pembelajaran yang diberikan selama perjalanan studinya.

Kelulusan Arifa, Yusfan, dan Hammam memperlihatkan peran lingkungan riset yang kolaboratif dalam mendukung penyelesaian pendidikan dan pengembangan kemampuan mahasiswa. Pengalaman ketiganya menunjukkan bahwa diskusi yang terbuka, dukungan antarrekan, serta kesempatan kolaborasi dapat membantu mahasiswa menghadapi tantangan penelitian.

Dengan bekal pengetahuan dan pengalaman tersebut, ketiganya diharapkan dapat terus berkontribusi melalui pengembangan ilmu dan teknologi pertanian. Riset mengenai pemantauan tanaman, pengelolaan irigasi, dan pemupukan presisi menjadi bagian dari upaya menghadirkan pertanian yang lebih efisien, adaptif, dan berkelanjutan.

#### Keterkaitan dengan SDGs

-   SDG 2 – Tanpa Kelaparan, melalui penelitian yang mendukung pengelolaan tanaman dan pengembangan teknologi produksi pangan.
-   SDG 4 – Pendidikan Berkualitas, melalui penyelesaian pendidikan magister, pembelajaran berbasis riset, serta pertukaran pengetahuan dalam lingkungan akademik.
-   SDG 6 – Air Bersih dan Sanitasi Layak, melalui penelitian pemodelan dan pengendalian irigasi yang diarahkan untuk mendukung pengelolaan air pertanian.
-   SDG 9 – Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur, melalui pengembangan sistem pemantauan tanaman, model kendali irigasi, dan pemetaan pemupukan berbasis teknologi.
-   SDG 12 – Konsumsi dan Produksi yang Bertanggung Jawab, melalui penelitian yang mendukung penggunaan air, pupuk, dan sumber daya pertanian secara lebih terarah.
-   SDG 17 – Kemitraan untuk Mencapai Tujuan, melalui kerja sama riset, pembelajaran antarmahasiswa, serta kolaborasi akademik internasional.
